from PIL import Image; import numpy as np
def load(n):
    im=np.asarray(Image.open('observations/obs_%04d.png'%n).convert('RGB')).astype(int)
    return im[:,:,0],im[:,:,1],im[:,:,2]
poses={170:(3.452,7.149),171:(3.452,6.399),172:(3.452,5.649)}
for n in (170,171,172):
    R,G,B=load(n); px,py=poses[n]
    print('=== f%d pose (%.3f,%.3f) h=180 SOUTH  (image right = WEST) ==='%(n,px,py))
    for u in [20,60,100,150,200,256,300,350,400,450,500]:
        prev=None; out=[]
        for v in range(80,512):
            t=(R[v,u]//16,G[v,u]//16,B[v,u]//16)
            if t!=prev: out.append('%d:(%d,%d,%d)'%(v,R[v,u],G[v,u],B[v,u])); prev=t
        print(' u%3d'%u,' '.join(out[:9]))
    print()
" 2>/dev/null
